description: Connects a protein to the Enzyme Commission (EC) classification associated with its UniProt annotation. Partial EC annotations can link to a class, subclass, or sub-subclass rather than a full four-part enzyme entry.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Source attribution for the protein EC annotation: UniProt.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the edge was created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Proteins with non-empty EC annotations, without organism or reviewed/Swiss-Prot restrictions, whose EC classification is represented by an EC node. Links may include obsolete EC entries.
source_contributions.description: The EC annotations originate from UniProt. Fully specified annotations identify full enzyme entries; partial annotations identify the corresponding broader EC classification.
